$comment: Task-branch model: implementers commit and push their own task/* branch and lease-push it after a rebase; nobody but the main session commits on main or master; a task branch is deleted only after GitHub shows its PR merged; the project keeps its own git hooks under tools/git-hooks. One usage line at 75% that the owner's override may lift; no stop line below 100%.

usage.holdAdvice: No new implementers. Finish work already in flight; a verifier for an already-launched task needs the owner's override. Otherwise wait for the reset or the owner's word.
